title: Model and validation
description: Historical checks, baselines and forecast limits. Inspection data for the target cases stays hidden.

pair.fromCommissioning: Historical check: pipes {{pipes}}, from commissioning to {{end}}.

r2Hint: Share of spread explained by a linear fit. Not R²
segmentsHint: Historical 10 m sections, not the hidden inspection
importanceCatboost: CatBoost importance normalised to sum to one. Not a local explanation of the ensemble forecast.
importanceLgbm: LightGBM importance normalised to sum to one. Not a causal effect.

uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
uncertainty.quantiles: Quantiles {{quantiles}}, a separate model for each.
uncertainty.coverage: Actual interval coverage is not calibrated.
uncertainty.bound: The interval does not guarantee thickness bounds.

limits.title: Limits of use
limits.level: The forecast refers to the minimum in a 10 m segment, not the wall shape around the circumference.
limits.pearson: r² measures linear association and does not guarantee a small absolute error.
limits.quantiles: P10 / P90 coverage has not been checked on an independent sample.
limits.neighbours: Neighbouring segments are dependent; a historical check is not a check on new pipes.
limits.regime: Operating regimes and ultrasonic thickness data may be incomplete.

comparison.title: Historical forecast and observation
comparison.separate: A separate saved run, not the selected model. Metrics are recalculated from rounded pairs.
comparison.label: Historical forecast versus observation, equal millimetre scales
comparison.reading: Dashed line: exact agreement. Below it forecasts underestimate thickness; above it they overestimate.
comparison.unavailable: Pairs do not match the split
comparison.mismatch: The archived series contains {{count}} pairs. Observations differ from the current historical split, so the chart is omitted.

metricsNote: {{total}} models on the same segments. Top {{shown}}, the selected model and baselines.
importanceNote: Top {{total}} features by importance share, each at least 1 %.
verdict: Historical check of the selected models: {{cases}}.
verdictCase: {{case}}, r² {{r2}} at MAE {{mae}} mm on {{n}} segments
maeHint: Mean absolute error on the same segments
metricsAll: {{total}} models on the same segments, all shown.
